about.what: Per-country subscription prices for Japan and South Korea, checked by hand-run scripts on official pricing pages and App Store In-App Purchase lists. Same format as docs/research/prices-mena-2026-11.json.
about.amounts: JPY and KRW have no minor unit, so amountMinor is the whole amount: ¥1,490 = 1490, ₩13,500 = 13500. Prices are the regular price after any free trial or intro offer.

status.verified: Read today from the official page in 'source'.
status.partial: Some plans read from the official page; others missing (see note).
status.unverified: Read from an official list but the amount is ambiguous (several prices under one name, or the page contradicts itself). Don't ship without checking.

about.taxes: Japan: 10% consumption tax. Japanese law requires consumer prices to be shown tax-included, and Apple, Amazon and Nintendo say so on their pages. Korea: 10% VAT. Spotify ('incl. VAT') and Nintendo say prices include it; Apple's iCloud+ page has no tax footnote for Korea. App Store prices in both countries include tax. Netflix's help page says taxes 'may be charged in addition'.
about.serviceIds: Match plan-ref ids (same plan = same id in every country). New or borrowed ids are named in each row's note: spotify 'basic' (Korea's Premium Basic, new), 'student' (as in the MENA file), google-ai-pro 'ultra' (as in the MENA file), discord-nitro 'nitro-yearly' (plan-ref id). Local services not in the catalog are in notChecked as candidates.
about.method: Pages read with curl or Playwright (chromium) from a US cloud IP using the country URL (e.g. help.netflix.com/en/node/24926/jp, spotify.com/kr-en/premium). App Store lists read from apps.apple.com/{cc}/app/id{ID}?l=en-GB (Apple shows at most 10 items). Sites that pick the country from the visitor's IP (youtube.com, disneyplus.com, canva.com, one.google.com, audible.co.jp, dazn.com, store.playstation.com) sent us the US version, so the App Store was used where its list was clear.
